## Modules

- [Podium.Chart.ComboChart.PlotSpec](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.ComboChart.PlotSpec.md): Specification for a single plot within a combo chart.

- Presentation API
  - [Podium](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.md): Elixir library for generating PowerPoint (.pptx) files with editable charts.
  - [Podium.Presentation](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Presentation.md): Internal module managing presentation state, slide collection, and serialization.
  - [Podium.Slide](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Slide.md): Represents a single slide in a presentation.

- Shapes and Drawing
  - [Podium.AutoShapeType](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.AutoShapeType.md): Maps auto shape preset atoms to OOXML preset geometry strings.
  - [Podium.Connector](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Connector.md): Connector shapes between two points.
  - [Podium.Drawing](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Drawing.md): DrawingML fill and line XML fragment generation.
  - [Podium.Freeform](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Freeform.md): Builder for freeform (custom geometry) shapes.
  - [Podium.Pattern](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Pattern.md): Maps pattern fill atoms to OOXML preset strings.
  - [Podium.Shape](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Shape.md): Shape structs and XML generation for text boxes, auto shapes, and freeform shapes.

- Text and Tables
  - [Podium.Table](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Table.md): Table struct and XML generation for slide tables.
  - [Podium.Text](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Text.md): Text normalization and paragraph XML generation.

- Charts
  - [Podium.Chart](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.md): Chart struct and XML generation for embedding charts in slides.
  - [Podium.Chart.BubbleChartData](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.BubbleChartData.md): Bubble chart data with X values, Y values, and bubble sizes per series.
  - [Podium.Chart.ChartData](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.ChartData.md): Category-based chart data for column, bar, line, pie, area, doughnut, and radar charts.
  - [Podium.Chart.ChartType](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.ChartType.md): Chart type to OOXML configuration mapping.
  - [Podium.Chart.ComboChart](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.ComboChart.md): Multi-type combo chart combining different chart types in one plot area.
  - [Podium.Chart.XyChartData](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.XyChartData.md): XY (scatter) chart data with numeric X and Y value pairs per series.

- Media
  - [Podium.Image](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Image.md): Embedded image with format auto-detection from magic bytes.
  - [Podium.Video](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Video.md): Embedded video with MIME-based extension detection.

- Slide Content
  - [Podium.CoreProperties](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.CoreProperties.md): Dublin Core metadata for presentation document properties.
  - [Podium.NotesSlide](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.NotesSlide.md): Speaker notes XML generation.
  - [Podium.Placeholder](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Placeholder.md): Layout placeholder management for slide content.
  - [Podium.Units](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Units.md): EMU (English Metric Units) conversion utilities.

- Internals
  - [Podium.Chart.XlsxWriter](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.XlsxWriter.md): Embedded Excel workbook generation for chart data.
  - [Podium.Chart.XmlWriter](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.Chart.XmlWriter.md): Chart XML generation for the chart part (`ppt/charts/chartN.xml`).
  - [Podium.OPC.Constants](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.OPC.Constants.md): OOXML namespace URIs, relationship types, and content type constants.
  - [Podium.OPC.ContentTypes](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.OPC.ContentTypes.md): `[Content_Types].xml` management for the OPC package.
  - [Podium.OPC.Package](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.OPC.Package.md): OPC (Open Packaging Convention) ZIP package read/write operations.
  - [Podium.OPC.Relationships](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.OPC.Relationships.md): `.rels` file management for OPC relationship parts.
  - [Podium.TemplatePlaceholders](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.TemplatePlaceholders.md): Template layout position parsing for content placeholders.
  - [Podium.XML.Builder](https://podium.hexdocs.pm/Podium.XML.Builder.md): XML declaration and character escaping utilities.
